tccolonybridge.configuration.title: TC Colony Bridge
tccolonybridge.configuration.maxRequests: Max requests delivered or crafted per cycle (limits cost per tick).
tccolonybridge.configuration.maxCraftPer: Largest amount sent to autocrafting for one request.
tccolonybridge.configuration.redeliveryC: Wait before serving the same request again, so the courier can pick it up.
tccolonybridge.configuration.craftFailCo: Wait before retrying an item whose craft failed (missing materials, no CPU...).
tccolonybridge.configuration.craftBlackl: Item IDs that are never autocrafted (e.g. "minecraft:diamond_block").
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCrafting: Craft for tag/tool/food requests when the network has no matching item.
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCraftPre: Default for bridges set to "Server default": which item to craft when several match (cheapest, most expensive or preferred list).
Item IDs in order of preference, used by bridges in "Preferred list" mode that have no preferred items of their own.
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCraftVan: Server rule: only Minecraft items for tag requests. Applies to every bridge; bridges cannot override it.
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCraftMax: Max craftable items compared per request (limits cost on huge networks).
tccolonybridge.configuration.craftCostDe: Recipe levels followed when estimating an item cost (more = more accurate and slower).
tccolonybridge.configuration.statsBucket: Size of each statistics time slot (6000 = 5 min). Changing it resets statistics.
How many time slots statistics keep (288 × 5 min = 24 h). Changing it resets statistics.
tccolonybridge.configuration.supplyMaxPe: Max items each Colony Supply line moves per cycle.
tccolonybridge.configuration.listMaxLine: Max lines in each list (Colony Supply Keep/Surplus, Bridge filter). Lowering it cuts the last lines of existing lists.
tccolonybridge.configuration.monitorMaxW: Max width (blocks) of a monitor screen.
tccolonybridge.configuration.monitorMaxH: Max height (blocks) of a monitor screen.
tccolonybridge.configuration.monitorLink: Max distance (blocks) between a monitor screen and its linked bridge.
gui.tccolonybridge.mods.empty: No craftable items in the ME network yet.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.general: Summary of the last cycle. Left bar: crafting on/off, redstone mode and tag craft preference. Per-request details and statistics are shown on a Colony Monitor linked to this bridge.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.filter: Each line is an item, a #tag or a @mod. + adds a line (type and press Enter, or click with an item / drag from JEI). Click a line's icon with an item to replace it; right-click cycles through the item's tags. Shift-click in the inventory adds a line. Left bar: filter mode and comparison.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.preferred: Order used by the "Preferred list" preference: 1st slot first. Empty = the server config list is used. Same controls as the filter.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.mods: Click a mod to mark it. The left bar button chooses how marked mods are used: all, only marked, all except marked or prefer marked. Only mods with craftable items in your ME network are listed.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.supply: Keep: items come from the ME network until the warehouse has at least the amount (a #tag counts the sum of its items). Surplus: anything above the amount goes back to the ME network (never while the colony is requesting it); ∞ sends everything. Each line is an item, #tag or @mod (@mod only in Surplus). Mouse wheel over the amount: ±1, Shift ±10, Ctrl ±64. Amount 0 turns the line off.
gui.tccolonybridge.supply.keep_rule: Keeps at least %s in the warehouse; what is missing comes from the ME network.
gui.tccolonybridge.supply.surplus_rule: Keeps at most %s in the warehouse; anything above goes back to the ME network.
tooltip.tccolonybridge.warehouse_termina: Shows every item in the colony warehouse racks; take and store items like an ME terminal.
Needs a regular ME cable below, power, and this colony's Colony Bridge on the same network.
gui.tccolonybridge.terminal.title: TC Warehouse Terminal
gui.tccolonybridge.terminal.sort.name: Sort: name
gui.tccolonybridge.help.terminal: Items of every warehouse rack. Left click: take a stack · Right click: half a stack · Shift: straight to the inventory. With an item on the cursor: left stores all, right stores one. Shift-click in the inventory stores the stack. Search with @ for a mod (@minecraft) and # for a tag (#c:ingots); right click the search box to clear it. Crafting: after each craft the grid is refilled from the warehouse; Shift-click on the result crafts up to a stack. JEI "+" fills the grid from the warehouse. ▲ returns the grid to the warehouse, ▼ to your inventory; closing the screen returns it to the warehouse.
message.tccolonybridge.terminal.no_colon: This terminal is not inside a colony.
tccolonybridge.configuration.terminalSyn: Ticks between warehouse reads while a Warehouse Terminal screen is open.
tccolonybridge.configuration.terminalMax: Max item types shown by the Warehouse Terminal (limits traffic for huge warehouses).
gui.tccolonybridge.terminal.clear_grid: Return the crafting grid to the warehouse
gui.tccolonybridge.terminal.missing: Missing in the warehouse and inventory
monitor.tccolonybridge.supply.chart: Items brought from the ME network, per hour
monitor.tccolonybridge.supply.section_ke: Keep in the warehouse · comes from the ME network
monitor.tccolonybridge.supply.section_su: Surplus · goes back to the ME network

tccolonybridge.configuration.bridgeIdleP: Idle AE/t used by the Colony Bridge (applies when the block loads).
tccolonybridge.configuration.supplyIdleP: Idle AE/t used by the Colony Supply Interface (applies when the block loads).
tccolonybridge.configuration.terminalIdl: Idle AE/t used by the Warehouse Terminal (applies when the block loads).
tccolonybridge.configuration.terminalEne: AE spent for each item the Warehouse Terminal moves between the warehouse and the player.
gui.tccolonybridge.terminal.grid_to_inve: Move the crafting grid to your inventory
gui.tccolonybridge.supply.surplus_all_ru: Sends everything back to the ME network (except items the colony is requesting).
gui.tccolonybridge.list.empty: Empty list. Click + or drop an item on it.
gui.tccolonybridge.list.draft: Click with an item, drag from JEI or type an id, #tag or @mod
gui.tccolonybridge.list.all_on: All: sends everything (click to use an amount)
gui.tccolonybridge.list.icon_hint: Click with an item: replace · Right-click: cycle its tags
gui.tccolonybridge.list.bad_syntax: Invalid text: use an item id, #tag or @mod
gui.tccolonybridge.list.missing: %s does not exist in this modpack

tablet.tccolonybridge.hint: Right-click: the colony's blocks, from anywhere. Charge it in the Bridge.
gui.tccolonybridge.charger.empty: Put the tablet here to charge and link it
tccolonybridge.configuration.tabletUsePe: FE the tablet spends per tick while a screen is open through it (0 = free).
tccolonybridge.configuration.tabletCharg: FE per tick the Bridge charger puts into the tablet (taken from the ME network, converted from AE).
tablet.tccolonybridge.closed.no_tablet: Tablet closed: hold the tablet linked to this colony
tablet.tccolonybridge.closed.block_gone: Tablet closed: the block is gone or its chunk is not loaded

tablet.tccolonybridge.unavailable: This block is not available (missing or chunk not loaded)
tooltip.tccolonybridge.colony_chunk_load: Keeps the colony's claimed chunks loaded, paying AE energy per chunk.
One per colony; normal ME cable underneath. Releases the area hours after the last member leaves.
gui.tccolonybridge.loader.state.countdow: Loading — no member online, counting down
gui.tccolonybridge.loader.state.no_power: No ME energy: only this block's chunk is loaded
gui.tccolonybridge.loader.state.sleeping: Area released: waiting for a colony member
gui.tccolonybridge.help.loader: Keeps the colony's claimed chunks loaded (nearest to the town hall first, up to the server maximum), spending AE energy per chunk. When the last colony member leaves the server, a countdown starts; at the end the area is released and only this block's chunk stays loaded until a member returns. Left bar: on/off and redstone.
tccolonybridge.configuration.chunkLoader: false = every Chunk Loader releases its chunks.
Max chunks per loader (nearest to the colony center first). Bypasses FTB Chunks force-load limits.
AE energy per tick per loaded chunk (includes the block's own chunk).
Real-time hours the area stays loaded after the last colony member leaves. 0 = release at once; fractions allowed.
How often the loader re-reads the colony's claimed chunks.
Seconds the area loads without ME energy when a member returns, so the ME network can start.
tooltip.tccolonybridge.pattern_encoder.l: Lists colony requests that the ME network cannot craft and encodes crafting patterns for them.
Needs a plain ME cable below and power. One per colony; uses 1 Blank Pattern per pattern.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.encoder: Colony requests the ME network cannot craft, with the crafting table recipe found for each. Put Blank Patterns in the left slot (when it is empty, they come from the ME network). Click a ready line to encode it, or use the side button to encode all of them. Take the patterns from the output slots to a Pattern Provider or Molecular Assembler. Lines that are not ready: no crafting table recipe (furnace, machines, items with special data) or Domum Ornamentum items.
gui.tccolonybridge.encoder.encode_all: Encode every ready line (1 Blank Pattern each)
gui.tccolonybridge.encoder.empty: No colony request is missing a pattern.
tccolonybridge.configuration.encoderIdle: Idle power of the TC Pattern Encoder, in AE/t (applies when the block is placed or reloaded).
tccolonybridge.configuration.encoderScan: Minimum ticks between scans of the colony requests while the Pattern Encoder screen is open.
tccolonybridge.configuration.encoderMaxL: Max lines (items without a pattern) shown by the Pattern Encoder.
